reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created from October to December 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
mrr AS (  -- one row per cohort account and month offset from 0 to 3, with the MRR at that month's end
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month, k.month_offset, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e
    ON e.account_id = c.account_id
   AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL (k.month_offset + 1) MONTH
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cohort_month, k.month_offset
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 0 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 0) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 1 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 2 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 2) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 3 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 3) END AS m3
FROM mrr
GROUP BY cohort_month

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created from October to December 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
mrr AS (  -- one row per cohort account and month offset from 0 to 3, with the MRR at that month's end
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month, k.month_offset, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e
    ON e.account_id = c.account_id
   AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL (k.month_offset + 1) MONTH
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cohort_month, k.month_offset
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       AVG(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 0) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 1 THEN NULL
            ELSE AVG(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 2 THEN NULL
            ELSE AVG(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 2) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= 3 THEN NULL
            ELSE AVG(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE month_offset = 3) END AS m3
FROM mrr
GROUP BY cohort_month

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created from October to December 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
flags AS (  -- one row per cohort account, 1 when its MRR is above 0 at the end of each month offset
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month,
         CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                    WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS a0,
         CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                    WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS a1,
         CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                    WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS a2,
         CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                    WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 4 MONTH) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS a3
  FROM cohort c
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       AVG(a0) AS m0,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE AVG(a1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE AVG(a2) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE AVG(a3) END AS m3
FROM flags
GROUP BY cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH coh AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
cells AS (
  SELECT c.cohort_month, c.account_id, k.off,
         CAST(c.cohort_month + (k.off + 1) * INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - 1 AS me
  FROM coh c, (SELECT unnest([0,1,2,3]) AS off) k
),
act AS (
  SELECT cells.cohort_month, cells.account_id, cells.off, cells.me,
         (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e WHERE e.account_id = cells.account_id AND e.event_date <= cells.me) AS mrr
  FROM cells
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN off = 0 THEN me END) > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 0 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 0) END AS m0,
       CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN off = 1 THEN me END) > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 1 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 1) END AS m1,
       CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN off = 2 THEN me END) > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 2 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 2) END AS m2,
       CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN off = 3 THEN me END) > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 3 AND mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE off = 3) END AS m3
FROM act
GROUP BY cohort_month
